concepts.def: Placed side by side for contrast
Hints at something later in the text
Represents an idea in physical form
Brings a feeling or image to mind

walkthroughs.body_html:
The Inspector embodies socialist values.

"Embodies" is stronger than "represents" — it suggests the values are made flesh through the character.

Use subverts when a writer overturns a norm.

Brontë subverts Victorian expectations of women by giving Jane Eyre fierce moral authority.

Evokes is great for atmosphere: the imagery evokes a sense of menace.

Critiques shows you understand the writer's argument: Priestley critiques the capitalist class.
